==Enemies==
'''Null''' may refer to these event enemies:
*[[Null Accelerator]], a high health enemy that appeared in [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Accelerator/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Beast]], a fast, high health enemy that appeared in [[Nil Zone]], and in [[Outpost 16|Night I]], [[Banlands|Night II]] and [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Beast/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Brawler]], a high health enemy that appeared in [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Brawler/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Commander]], a major boss that appeared in [[Outpost 16|Night I]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
*[[Null Crook Boss]], a high health enemy that spawns the [[Null Goon]] on death, that appeared in [[Outpost 16|Night I]], [[Banlands|Night II]] and [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Crook Boss/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Dredge]], an enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 16|Night I]], [[Banlands|Night II]] and [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Dredge/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Electroshocker]], a fast enemy that appeared in [[Banlands|Night II]] and [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Electroshocker/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Engineer]], a high health summoner enemy that appeared in [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Engineer/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Freezer]], a fast enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 16|Night I]], [[Banlands|Night II]] and [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Freezer/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Goon]], a hidden enemy spawned by the [[Null Crook Boss]] upon its death, that appeared in [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
*[[Null Guardian]], a major boss that appeared in [[Banlands|Night II]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
*[[Null Guardian Clone]], a high health enemy spawned by the [[Null Guardian]]
*[[Nulling]], an enemy that appeared in [[Nil Zone]], and in [[Outpost 16|Night I]], [[Banlands|Night II]] and [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Nulling/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Medic]], a high health enemy that can heal enemies, that appeared in [[Banlands|Night II]] and [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Medic/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Missile APC]], an enemy spawned by the [[Null Commander]]
*[[Null Necromancer]], a high health summoner enemy that appeared in [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Necromancer/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Pursuit]], a high health flying enemy that appeared in [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Pursuit/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Pyromancer]], a high health enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 16|Night I]], [[Banlands|Night II]] and [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Pyromancer/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Runner]], a fast enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 16|Night I]], [[Banlands|Night II]] and [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Runner/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Scout]], an enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 16|Night I]], [[Banlands|Night II]] and [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Scout/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Sentry]], an immobile enemy spawned by the [[Null Engineer]]
*[[Null Shrieker]], a flying enemy that appeared in [[Banlands|Night II]] and [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Shrieker/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Null Warden]], a high health enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 16|Night I]], [[Banlands|Night II]] and [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]
**[[Null Warden/Advanced Stats]]
